title: helm: validate private.values schema and stabilize init-hooks for upgrade/rollback
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: private Helm chart's init-hooks and values schema were causing unpredictable failures during upgrades and rollbacks in private deployments (VPC/on-prem). This PR tightens the values schema, adds stricter validation for required fields, and stabilizes init hook behavior to make upgrade/rollback sequences deterministic.

Changes: 
- Add chart/values.schema.json with exhaustive schema for private.values including k8s resource annotations, initHook settings, and upgrade/rollback flags.
- Add pre-upgrade and pre-rollback init job templates (chart/templates/init-pre-upgrade-job.yaml, chart/templates/init-pre-rollback-job.yaml) that are idempotent and use leader-election to avoid multi-pod races.
- Move legacy init logic into chart/templates/init-helpers.tpl and add a feature flag private.init.enabled to control behavior.
- Add helm tests in chart/tests/ ensuring schema validates and hooks run in dry-run mode.
- Update README and values.yaml examples for private deployments and document upgrade notes.

Migration/Upgrade notes: 
- The new values.schema.json will reject malformed private.values; customers should run `helm lint --values values.yaml` before applying.
- For clusters that relied on implicit init ordering, enable `private.init.legacyMode=true` during a transitional release and perform a canary rollout. The PR includes a migration checklist in the README.

Testing: 
- Unit: Helm schema linting added to CI.
- Integration: CI runs a k3s-based test that simulates upgrade+rollback sequences; caught and fixed a race where multiple init jobs would try to update the same ConfigMap.
- Staging: Deployed to staging-private and ran 3 sequential upgrade/rollback iterations without failure.

Related: Linear ENG-5421 (helm private values schema), ENG-5489 (init hook upgrade/rollback flakiness).
